tools.description: Read video frames from a workspace file or an external file with an active single-file read grant for this conversation; ReadOnly is allowed. Supply exactly one of times (1 to 12 requested times in seconds, from zero up to but excluding the duration) or count (1 to 12 uniformly spaced frames). sheet=true returns one contact sheet with time labels; otherwise each frame is an image. max_side bounds the longest side of each final image, including the whole sheet: default 1024, range 64 to 2048. Each result reports requested_time and actual_time. For an image-capable model, the newest media.frames result's images accompany the next request with shown_to_model=true, alongside the latest 3 browser screenshots. A model without image input receives times and an explicit explanation that it cannot see the images. You cannot hear the audio; this tool performs no audio transcription. Unsupported codecs and decoding timeouts return an explicit error.

tools.description: Delete a file or a folder with everything in it by moving it to the Recycle Bin, where the user can restore it. Use this for deletions: a Shell command that deletes (Remove-Item, del, rd, rm, git clean …) deletes for good, nothing can restore it, and outside 完全访问 Aura asks the user about each one, so run one only when the user asks for it or this tool cannot do the job. If the Recycle Bin cannot take the item (a drive with no Recycle Bin, an item larger than the bin holds), nothing is deleted and the call says so. permanent: true deletes for good and asks the user every time, in every mode: use it only when the user asked for that, or after the Recycle Bin refused.
